column1: Survey-weighted estimates. BA columns: logit average marginal effects. Income columns: OLS coefficients. Covariates include: sex, native language, region and urbanicity, socioeconomic status, race, number of extracurriculars, age, teacher-student relation, parental aspirations, parental education, student preparation for class, student education and occupational expectations, school poverty, school sector, composite test scores, family composition, and perceived school safety.
